question: Can a generic online hypothesis tournament infer an unsupplied causal law, archive it, and reactivate it when the law returns faster than matched fully trained controls?
hypothesis: Archive-augmented Bayesian tournament over all 256 three-bit Boolean causal laws may reduce early return-to-old-law Brier versus an identically configured uncached tournament and rolling-count control. A symbolic controller already told the three true law masks should be stronger. No source-qualified scientific gain is possible here.

synthetic_fixture.license: Original source-free code; no protected or imported dataset
synthetic_fixture.worlds: A=parity(a,x,z); B=(a AND z) XOR x; C=(a ? (x AND z) : (x XOR z)). Three truth-table identities known to the harness and informed symbolic upper bound, NOT to the generic tournament or count controls.
synthetic_fixture.sampling: For seed,t,input, SHA256('CSRR03:'+seed+':'+t+':'+input) first uint32/2^32 compared to Bernoulli with P(y=truth)=.85; public input=(5*t+seed)%8; one observed consequence to every learner.
synthetic_fixture.interpretation: Every three-bit Boolean function is enumerated. Law identity is unknown but its representational family is PREPROGRAMMED. No independent unfamiliar causal family or original-world first-use.

frozen_design.split: A,B,A,C,A,B, each 192 steps; first 32 steps of A return phases indexed 2 and 4 are the revival diagnostic; no post-result seed adjustment
frozen_design.ordering: t=0..1151 per seed, input=(5*t+seed)%8; identical consequence, action and context evidence supplied to all candidate/controls
frozen_design.data_budget: 3456 synthetic observed action-consequences per learner; original-world actions zero
frozen_design.compute_budget: Node.js 22 standard library, 256-mask enumeration and rolling 32 witnesses; one primary process and one fresh-process reproduction
frozen_design.capacity: 256 masks; prior log penalty -.32 per 3-cube edge transition; Bernoulli model probabilities .85/.15; rolling witness window 32; archive FIFO up to four masks, insert only after eight consecutive MAP steps with full window; archived prior log-bonus .9; controls uncached same exact grammar/parameters, Beta(1,1) last-4 per-input counts, Beta(1,1) global counts, three-law symbolic Bayesian with same 32 witnesses (extra prior law identity)
frozen_design.evaluator: Harness-only analytic expected Bernoulli Brier averaged across 8 input cells BEFORE each shared observation; phase and law identities not exposed to candidate/uncached/counts. Cold SHA256 checkpoint after t=383, compare restored versus continuing candidate on all future predictions, same future updates.

controls: Uncached same-grammar and same-parameter fully updated 256-mask tournament
Informed three-law Bayesian symbolic comparator (upper bound, extra prior law identities)
Corrupted-checkpoint and invalid pre-action/public label negative controls
metrics: Early 32-step A-return Brier over uncached and rolling-count controls
A-return excess Brier over correct law Bernoulli floor .1275 must be <=+.02
Exact cold prediction mismatches; archive additions and reactivations; source/witness accounting

classification_rules.engineering_advantage_dev_only: Cold mismatch=0; changed-phase Brier improves >= .005 versus constant; return-world excess over .1275 <=+.020; early-return archive improves >=.005 over uncached; whole-run archive Brier improves >=.005 over BOTH rolling counts and informed symbolic. DEV only, never scientific PASS.
classification_rules.mixed_dev_only: Cold mismatch=0, changed-phase gain >= .005 against constant and return-world excess <=+.020, but fails >=.005 superiority to all strongest controls.
classification_rules.negative_dev_only: Valid execution but no >=.005 changed-phase gain over constant OR return-world Brier excess >+.020, or insufficient retention/transfer; preserve failed candidates.
classification_rules.invalid: Different action/outcome evidence, hidden phase/law/evaluator leakage, mismatch in 3456 witness count, altered frozen source, thresholds, data or cohorts, bad checkpoint acceptance, missing negatives, protected source use, primary results before prereg commit.

prohibited_after_primary_run: Changing seeds, law functions, thresholds, model scores or chosen controls
Reusing consumed CSRR01/02 cohorts as new
Source-family first-use, runner dispatch, merge, accepted-ref mutation, deployment
Claiming independent native scientific intelligence from synthetic result
preregistration_note: Commit this and exact study source before primary run, then execute only the preregistered three seeds, reproduce freshly without changing settings, and record evidence in a separate result commit.
